answer: Escrow plus a public referral graph blocks fakes. A new agent locks 60 POA for 20 epochs, names a sponsor; edges are public, so one sponsor feeding many shows as a star. Receipts, unique as opal, are never reused. Disputed suspects without distinct work lose deposit and sponsor stake. Making 1000 fakes costs 60000 POA; clones are velvet from one roll. An honest agent pays once, keeps rewards undiluted, recovers it, its record fixed like pigment.
